smell: Spinner step is modeled as optional S.Finite, so zero or negative steps decode even though the hook treats step as a positive increment/decrement magnitude; negative values invert the direction of increment/decrement.
proposedTarget: Introduce a local PositiveFiniteStep = S.Finite.check(S.isGreaterThan(0)).pipe($I.annoteSchema("PositiveFiniteStep", { description: "Positive step size for number input spinner changes." })) and use S.optionalKey(PositiveFiniteStep). S.isGreaterThan is verified at .repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:7286; keep BoundaryParams min/max/value as S.Finite because negative and fractional numeric values are valid there.

proposedTarget: Tighten id and label to S.NonEmptyString (verified .repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:8420) and pipe each through $I.annoteKey("NotificationAction.id"/"NotificationAction.label", { description: ... }).
